parole.significato: digital font (set of glyphs of unified design contained in a computer file)
parole.testo: Unadapted borrowing from English font, from Middle French fonte, feminine past participle of fondre (“to melt”), from Latin fundō (“to melt”).

parole.significato: terror (especially the action or quality of causing dread)
parole.testo: Orthographic borrowing from English terror, from Latin terror.
